name: Passport & ID photo
description: Crop and resize a photo to official passport, visa and ID sizes. Pick a country, line your face up with the guide, then download a print-ready image.

seo.metaTitle: Passport & ID photo — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Crop and resize a photo to official passport, visa and ID sizes. Pick a country, line your face up with the guide, then download a print-ready image. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/photo/passport-photo-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Passport & ID photo processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/photo/passport-photo-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Passport & ID photo upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Passport & ID photo executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/photo/passport-photo-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does Passport & ID photo upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Passport & ID photo executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/photo/passport-photo-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Passport & ID photo?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/passport_photo.json or open /tools/passport-photo?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Passport & ID photo?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/passport_photo.json or open /tools/passport-photo?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.

steps: Select or drop your image into the browser workspace.
Configure processing parameters and preview the updated image in real time.
Download your final processed image directly to your device with 0 server uploads.
